title: Типизированные package errors и compiled ProblemRegistry
summary: Реализовать ErrorCode/ProblemDefinition/registry и coded exception hierarchy; заменить литералы и unsafe dynamic reconstruction типизированными enum/lookup с boot validation.
why: D10/D64; 85 constructors and fixture dynamic adapters currently accept unscoped strings, replay must restore a validated error identity.

include: Core contracts/Data/registry/exceptions; package owned enums/contributions and exception descriptors across all packages; 85 site map, optional packages boot tests, literal gate, dynamic persistence/queue adapters, descriptor fixtures/hash map, existing serializers/snapshots/docs code values. Kernel remains independently bootable.
exclude: Новая HTTP negotiation/problem+json policy P06, new retry scheduling behavior, central closed enum of ecosystem codes, schema/data migrations, tag/release.

rules: Коды string wire, enum object in constructors; no compatibility aliases or generic raw-code escape hatch. Prefix authority bound to composer owner, duplicate/foreign code/type fails boot. Registry compile once + freeze, no feature dependencies in kernel. Preserve category/path/retryable/details semantics; status remains occurrence projection consistent with registry. Unknown persisted code and unexpected Throwable yield safe registered core error, never arbitrary user string. HTTP transport changes P06.
guidance: dossier §3.3 fixed registry boundaries + examples §4; error-code-map site ownership. Frontier judgement chooses package exception definitions from current semantics and tests; every code has declaration/type/status/category/retryability, no unregistered cases.

validation.procedure: - `scripts/php84 php scripts/error-registry.php --check` → exit 0, no literal/unregistered/duplicate/foreign-prefix/type diagnostics, enumerated package-owned catalogue.

- core isolated Testbench boot without operations/Flex, optional-package contribution and registry freeze fixtures pass. Negative duplicate-code/foreign-prefix/duplicate-URI/invalid-status fixtures fail boot with exact typed diagnostics.
- New literal via alias/group-use/FQCN + dynamic raw string call fixtures fail `ERROR-LITERAL`/constructor type check; valid enum/registered restored value passes.

- `scripts/php84 composer test -- --filter='ErrorContract|StoredOperationOutcome|Idempotency'` → descriptor semantics, safe unexpected failure, persisted replay roundtrip GREEN; affected per-package exception suites pass.
- `scripts/php84 composer api-contract` → current snapshots use scoped code/type with no unrelated profile/pagination/auth delta.
- `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --strict` → exit 0 including newly added types.
- `scripts/php84 composer lint:check`, `scripts/php84 composer analyse` → exit 0; `php scripts/quality-ceiling-guard.php` → `ceilings OK`; no threshold weakening.

- `scripts/php84 composer test`, `PGSQL_PORT=5432 scripts/php84 composer test:pg`, `scripts/php84 composer test:packages`, `scripts/php84 composer test:arch` → exit 0; isolated `_test` DB preflight before DB tests, PHP8.4 required. Existing P03 count is reference, preserved behavior proven by affected assertions.
- `scripts/php84 composer golden` → 4 tests pass **without** GOLDEN_UPDATE. D64 preimage/candidate/semantic-delta/review proves each updated layer; routes byte-identical to item preimage.

- `php scripts/rename-completeness-gate.php`, `php scripts/ownership-gate.php --strict`, `php scripts/package-docs-gate.php`, `bash scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh`, `bash scripts/mutation-check.sh --all` → exit 0 (new gates get negative controls; preserve 34 existing mutation cases).

- Independent review: execution-sheet reviewer/effort, fresh context; reviewer model != executor; item-spec + diff + Validation + semantic delta; `review: <provider>/<model> <GREEN|findings:N>`; <=2 fix/recheck rounds, then concrete unresolved boundary evidence.

deliverables: `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P04.3-execution/error-registry.json`; Core registry и package typed codes/errors; `artifacts/P04.3-execution/error-registry.json`, typed site map + boot/literal/replay evidence, approved php-surface/wire delta, `completion.md`.
